title: LifeVerse
description: Welcome to LifeVerse, a vanilla++ modpack for the good folk in the Lifeline server.
body: LifeVerse is a tailored experience of a multiplayer modpack, with mods ranging from vanilla+ additions to strange and out-there mods. LifeVerse SMP is a sideserver of the Lifeline games. It is not currently open to new players.
